summary: Nokia filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine transfer of 975,289 treasury shares to participants of its equity-based incentive plans, with no consideration paid. The transfer was authorized by the Board on 2 October 2025, and post-transfer treasury shares total 132,353,333. This is a standard compensation-related share issuance, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or regulatory mechanics apply. This is a routine corporate action with no event-driven or special-situations implications; the filing serves only as a report of share count changes under Nokia's incentive plan.
